title: Privacy Policy
intro: {{shopName}} operates this store. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, share, and protect your personal data when you visit or shop on {{websiteUrl}}, in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (“DPDP Act”) and applicable rules made thereunder. By using the website, you agree to the practices described in this Policy.

sections.label: Who We Are
sections.title: Who We Are
sections.intro: {{shopName}} is the “Data Fiduciary” under the DPDP Act for the personal data collected through this website — meaning we determine the purpose and means of processing your personal data.

items.title: Registered Address
items.text: {{address}}

items.title: Contact Email
items.text: {{contactEmail}}

items.title: Contact Phone

sections.label: Information We Collect
sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.intro: We collect only the data necessary to provide our services. This includes:

rows: Name, email address, phone number, billing/shipping address
Order history, items purchased, order value, payment status
Payment method, transaction ID (card/UPI details are processed directly by our payment gateway and not stored by us)
Messages sent via contact form, customer support, WhatsApp/SMS (if used)
IP address, browser type, device type, pages visited, time spent, referral source
Automatically, via cookies and analytics tools
Email/SMS subscription status, ad interaction data

sections.closing: We do not knowingly collect any special category data such as health information, religious beliefs, or biometric data through this website.

items.title: Directly from you
items.text: When you create an account, place an order, sign up for our newsletter, or contact customer support.

items.title: Automatically
items.text: Through cookies, web beacons, and tracking tools when you browse the website.

items.title: From third parties
items.text: Such as our payment gateway (confirming payment status) or courier partner (confirming delivery status).

sections.label: Purpose of Processing
sections.title: Purpose of Processing Your Data
sections.intro: We process your personal data strictly for the following itemized purposes:

items.title: To fulfil orders
items.text: Processing payments, generating invoices, and arranging delivery of your {{catalogLabel}} via our courier/logistics partner.

items.title: To verify your identity
items.text: For account security and fraud prevention (e.g., OTP/phone verification).

items.title: To communicate with you
items.text: Order confirmations, shipping updates, and responses to support queries.

items.title: To send marketing communications
items.text: Only if you have opted in; you may withdraw this consent at any time.

items.title: To improve the website
items.text: Analyzing browsing behaviour to improve product listings, site performance, and user experience.

items.title: To run advertising campaigns
items.text: Measuring ad performance via analytics and advertising tools, with your consent where required.

items.title: To comply with legal obligations
items.text: Such as tax records, consumer protection requirements, or law enforcement requests.

sections.closing: We do not use your data for any purpose beyond what is stated above without seeking fresh consent.

sections.label: Consent
sections.title: Consent
sections.intro: We seek your consent before collecting personal data for purposes that require it (such as marketing communications). Consent is free, specific, informed, and unambiguous — given through a clear affirmative action (e.g., checking a box, signing up for our newsletter).
sections.closing: You can withdraw your consent at any time by emailing {{contactEmail}}, using the “unsubscribe” link in marketing emails/SMS, or through your account settings (if applicable).

sections.label: Cookies & Tracking
sections.title: Cookies & Tracking Technologies
sections.intro: Our website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience, remember your cart, and measure marketing performance. You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings.

items.title: Essential cookies
items.text: Required for the website to function, including checkout, cart, and account access.

items.title: Analytics cookies
items.text: Help us understand how visitors use the site so we can improve it.

items.title: Preference cookies
items.text: Remember your settings and choices for a more personal experience.

items.title: Marketing cookies
items.text: Used to show relevant offers. These are used only with your consent where required.

sections.label: How We Share
sections.title: How We Share Your Information
sections.intro: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only with trusted service providers (“Data Processors”) strictly to the extent necessary to operate our business:

rows: Order delivery, KYC where mandated by courier regulations
Securely storing website data, images, backups
Account and order data (stored, not shared for marketing)
Measuring site usage and ad performance
Device/usage data, hashed contact data (where applicable)

sections.closing: These providers are contractually bound to use your data only for the purpose we have engaged them for. We may also disclose your data if required by law, court order, or government request.

sections.label: Data Retention
sections.title: Data Retention
sections.intro: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes outlined in this Policy.

items.title: Order & transaction data
items.text: Retained for the duration required under applicable tax and consumer protection laws (typically up to 7 years for financial records).

items.title: Account data
items.text: Retained while your account remains active, or until you request deletion.

items.title: Marketing data
items.text: Retained until you withdraw consent or unsubscribe.

sections.label: Data Security
sections.title: Data Security
sections.intro: We implement reasonable security safeguards including SSL/TLS encryption, secure cloud storage with access controls, and PCI-DSS compliant payment processing. We do not store your full card details on our servers.

sections.label: Your Rights
sections.title: Your Rights as a Data Principal
sections.intro: Under the DPDP Act, you have the right to:

items.title: Access
items.text: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.

items.title: Correction
items.text: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.

items.title: Erasure
items.text: Request deletion of your personal data, where it is no longer necessary for the purpose it was collected for.

items.title: Withdraw Consent
items.text: At any time, for any consent-based processing (e.g., marketing).

items.title: Grievance Redressal
items.text: Raise a complaint regarding how we handle your data.

items.title: Nominate a Representative
items.text: To exercise your rights on your behalf in case of death or incapacity.

sections.closing: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at {{contactEmail}}.

sections.label: Children
sections.title: Children's Privacy
sections.intro: The {{shopName}} website and {{catalogLabel}} are not directed at children under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

sections.label: Changes
sections.title: Changes to This Policy
sections.intro: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The “Last Updated” date on this page will indicate when the latest revision was made.

sections.label: Contact Us
sections.title: Contact Us
sections.intro: For any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, reach out to {{shopName}}.
